# E0903: thema reported an error that has no code

thema reported an error as plain text, with no code, no position and no
structure. Every one of these is a gap: the place in thema that produced it has
not been given a code yet. The detail holds the text.

## Example

`error.txt`:

```
could not open the lineage: permission denied
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0903]: thema reported an error that has no code
  |
  = detail: could not open the lineage: permission denied
```
